title: The kb MCP coord tools and the coord hook use different stores by default, so a session's coord_digest never sees the hook's intents
goal: (SP-xo45jvbj review G5) With no KB_COORD_STORE and no KB_COORD_URL, coord.py uses kb-coord/coord.sqlite in the common git directory of the clone that holds it, the store the coord hook uses; the kb MCP coord tools and coord.py dedup as /kb-research step 0 runs it share that store with the hook

run:
import json,os,sys
for k in ('KB_COORD_STORE','KB_COORD_URL','KB_COORD_KEY_FILE'):os.environ.pop(k,None)
os.environ['KB_COORD_TOOLS']='1'
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kb_mcp
r=kb_mcp.handle({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'coord_digest','arguments':{'key':['ST-xo45jvbj'],'lines':3}}})
res=r.get('result') or {};print(json.dumps(res)[:300]);sys.exit(0 if res.get('isError') is False else 1)

import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,uuid
E={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("KB_COORD")}
common=os.path.abspath(s.run(["git","rev-parse","--git-common-dir"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip())
F=dict(E,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(common,"kb-coord","coord.sqlite"))
K="planning-check/"+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
def c(env,*a):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py",*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=300);return p.returncode,p.stdout
rc,out=c(E,"claim",K,"--ttl","5","--holder","planning-check")
seen=c(F,"get",K)[0] if rc==0 else None
code="import json,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kb_mcp;r=kb_mcp.handle({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'coord_digest','arguments':{'key':[sys.argv[1]],'lines':3}}});print(json.dumps(r))"
m=s.run([sys.executable,"-c",code,K],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(E,KB_COORD_TOOLS="1"),timeout=120).stdout
mcp=("claim "+K) in m
if rc==0:c(E,"release",K,"--token",json.loads(out)["token"])
d=c(E,"dedup","zzqx planning check of the default coord store","--holder","planning-check","--ttl","1")[0]
print(dict(claim_no_env=rc,default_store_sees_it=seen,mcp_digest_sees_it=mcp,dedup_no_env=d))
sys.exit(0 if rc==0 and seen==0 and mcp and d==0 else 1)

Ordered after BG-iwqcj5zf (coord.py, coord_hook.py) and ST-nlesmlru (kb_mcp.py): with ST-nlesmlru the coord tools are listed only under KB_COORD_TOOLS=1, so this item's repro sets KB_COORD_TOOLS=1 (the repro is updated in this item: it calls coord_digest through kb_mcp.handle). Repro updated at planning (2026-10-16) to set KB_COORD_TOOLS=1, so it still fails for the store (not for an unlisted tool) after ST-nlesmlru; it fails on origin/main ed55f4d56 with 'no store'.
